note: Strike Lab (issue #3; V0.1 was D190): arcade puzzle bowling with three challenges (Pin Pursuit, Word Strike, Physics Lab). Only the committed puzzle answers and spelled words are evidence; the warm-up ball, aim, power, spin, the test strip, rolls, pins down, retries, GUIDED SHOT and MOVE ON never are.

lines.intro: Earn your shots in the Strike Lab! Solve the puzzle, then knock down the glowing pins.
lines.practiceAsk: Start with a free warm-up throw. Try aim, power and spin, then BOWL!
lines.practiceDone: Nice warm-up! Now earn your shot.
lines.smartAsk: The Smart Ball needs {needed} power. It has {present}. Which module powers it up?
lines.smartWrong: That makes {total}. It needs {needed}. Try another module.
lines.smartReady: Powered up! Knock down the glowing pin.
lines.targetAsk: Make {target} with two pins. Tap two pins.
lines.targetWrong: {a} and {b} make {sum}. We need {target}. Try another pair.
lines.targetReady: Target locked! Knock down the glowing pins.
lines.fresh: New numbers! Take a fresh look.
lines.dotsTarget: Count the dots on the pins.
lines.showMe: Here it is. Tap the shining one.
lines.showPins: Here they are. Tap the shining pins.
lines.gutter: Gutter ball! Try a new aim.
lines.secondBall: Second ball! Go for the glowing pins.
lines.targetMiss: The glowing pins are still up!
lines.guidedOffer: Want a hand? GUIDED SHOT adds rails and shows a path that works. Or move on.
lines.guidedAsk: Line up your path with the green guide, then BOWL.
lines.guidedMiss: Almost! Try the guide again, or move on.
lines.guidedDone: Great effort! MOVE ON to the next one.
lines.movedOn: Good bowling! On to the next one.
lines.done: Round done! Thanks for bowling in the Strike Lab.
lines.introPursuit: Pin Pursuit! Pick two numbered pins that make the target, then knock them down. The pins stand in a new shape each time.
lines.introWord: Word Strike! Spell a word to unlock spin, then curve the ball around the post.
lines.introPhysics: Physics Lab! Earn your shot, then set the test strip slick or grippy and watch how the ball rolls.
lines.practiceLocked: Start with a free warm-up throw. Spin unlocks when you spell a word. Try aim and power, then BOWL!
lines.spellAsk: Spell the word to unlock spin! Tap the letters.
lines.spellWrong: Not quite yet. Try the letters again.
lines.spellReady: Spin unlocked! Curve the ball around the post to the glowing pin.
lines.spellShow: The word is {word}. Tap its letters.
lines.spellListen: Listen to the word, then tap its letters.
lines.surfaceReady: Powered up! Set the test strip, then knock down the glowing pin.
lines.surfaceSlick: Slick strip: the ball slides, and spin barely curves it.
lines.surfaceGrippy: Grippy strip: spin curves the ball hard, and it slows down.
lines.guidedSurface: The guide rolls on a {surface} strip. Switch the strip, then follow the guide.
lines.carried: Your earned shot is waiting! Knock down the glowing pins.
lines.pickLevel: Pick a challenge to play next!
